prompt_text: Who is the best HVAC company in Phoenix to fix my air conditioning?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” company, but **Phoenix Air Department** looks like a reasonable first call: it’s BBB-accredited with an A+ rating, advertises 24/7 service, and has a listed Arizona contractor license (ROC 329176). Call **(602) 598-5447**. [BBB profile](https://www.bbb.org/us/az/tempe/profile/air-conditioning-contractor/phoenix-air-department-1126-1000075398)

For a second quote, **1st Choice Mechanical** is also BBB-accredited and A+ rated, with 24-hour service listed. [BBB profile](https://www.bbb.org/us/az/phoenix/profile/air-conditioning-repair/1st-choice-mechanical-1126-1000062491)

Before booking, confirm the company’s current Arizona Registrar of Contractors license, ask about the diagnostic fee and any after-hours surcharge, and get the repair price and warranty in writing. If you share your Phoenix ZIP code and whether you need emergency service, I can help narrow it down.
